name: clean_scan
description: Import a scan mesh (STL/OBJ/PLY), merge duplicate vertices, optionally fill holes, recalc normals, optionally voxel-remesh, optionally decimate to a triangle budget, and export the result as STL. Reports triangles before/after and honest manifold status; this is mesh cleanup, not an editable B-Rep reconstruction.

input_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the scan mesh (.stl, .obj, or .ply).

output_path.description: Path for the cleaned STL export. A .stl suffix is recommended; one is appended when missing.

target_triangles.description: Triangle budget for decimation. Ignored when decimate is false or the mesh is already smaller.

voxel_size.description: Voxel remesh size in Blender units. 0 disables voxel remeshing.

fill_holes.description: Fill boundary loops left after import/merge.

decimate.description: Decimate to target_triangles when the mesh exceeds the budget.
